open_points.subject: _read_record
open_points.text: _read_record: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST open the state folder, the third folder above path, as it stands, also through a link, then each of the two folders below it in the one before through dir_fd as a folder without following a link, then the record file in the last of them for reading only, in non-blocking mode and without following a link, and MUST return None only when a folder on that path or the record file does not exist; a folder on the path that is a link or not a folder, a record that is a link or not a regular file by os.fstat of the opened descriptor, a failed opening or reading, content that is not UTF-8 JSON valid against model with no extra field, or a record whose project_id and source_id differ from the given ones MUST raise the DelivererError _state_unavailable returns; otherwise it MUST return the validated record. Every descriptor is closed on every path and nothing is written.
open_points.other_text: def _read_record(path: Path, model: type[BaseModel], project_id: UUID, source_id: str) -> BaseModel | None
open_points.question: Must the contract restrict model to models that declare project_id and source_id, or must the note stop requiring those fields for every type[BaseModel] accepted by the contract?

open_points.subject: _atomic_write
open_points.text: _atomic_write: [PATH_OR_ARTIFACT_POLICY] MUST call _make_folders for the folder of path below base with folder_mode and durable_folder, creating only the folders of this address and nothing ahead of use, then create a temporary file in that folder whose name is the imported TEMPORARY_NAME_PREFIX constant followed by a fresh name from secrets, exclusively and without following a link with the imported TEMPORARY_FILE_MODE constant, passing over a name that is taken and trying a fresh one; it MUST write all of content, set mode on the open file, os.fsync it, close it and os.replace it over path, so an existing file at path is never absent to a reader. When durable_folder is true it MUST then synchronise the folder of path with _sync_folder and any failure fails the write; when it is false that folder is synchronised after the rename and a failure there is neither raised nor undoes the file in place. A failure before the rename MUST remove the temporary file, leave it when that removal fails too, and raise the original OSError; a temporary file a crash leaves stays and is never read.

Нота остаётся требованием к
поведению: выражения, вызовы методов, точечная навигация и строковый
микро-синтаксис в ней запрещены.
open_points.question: The note must express the required synchronization and atomic replacement behavior without the dotted API references os.fsync and os.replace.

open_points.subject: _make_folders
open_points.text: _make_folders: [PATH_OR_ARTIFACT_POLICY] MUST make every folder from base down to folder exist, outermost first, creating only the folders on that path below base: base itself is used as it stands, also through a link; a folder found, created by any call of any process and whatever its mode, is accepted as it stands, and a creation that loses the race to another process is accepted when the entry is then a folder; a folder this call creates takes mode by os.chmod after os.mkdir, so the umask does not change it; an entry on the path that is a symbolic link or not a folder, checked without following a link, MUST raise OSError. When durable is true, each folder this call creates MUST be synchronised in its parent with _sync_folder before the next one is made. It removes nothing.

open_points.subject: _sync_folder
open_points.text: _sync_folder: [BEHAVIOR] MUST open the folder read-only as a folder, call os.fsync on that descriptor and close it on every path, letting any OSError pass to its caller.

open_points.subject: project_lock
open_points.text: project_lock: [BEHAVIOR] MUST be a contextlib.contextmanager generator that makes the folder of the imported LOCKS_FOLDER constant exist below the state_dir of context with _make_folders, the imported STATE_FOLDER_MODE constant and durable false, then creates the lock file named by the canonical project id followed by the imported LOCK_FILE_SUFFIX constant exclusively, without following a link, with the imported LOCK_FILE_MODE constant, or, when it exists, opens it as it stands without following a link; it MUST take fcntl.flock with fcntl.LOCK_EX on that descriptor, waiting without a time limit and with no retry of its own, yield once while holding it, and release and close it on every exit. Neither the lock file nor its folder is synchronised, a lock found partly created is completed and nothing created is removed.
